gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-kadwa: Kadwa brings open-ended curves and an unusually large x-height. Jelly Crazies, wobbly and nearly sealed in its bowls, earns its keep when it is big and brief, a playful shout above that classic voice.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-pridi: Wide gaps between curve ends and stems let small letters stand almost capital-sized. Pridi meets Jelly Crazies, whose pencil-like lines never thicken and whose bowls nearly close, so one voice stays tight and the other open.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-scope-one: Wobbly up top, refined below. Jelly Crazies keeps its bowls nearly shut while Scope One lets counters spill outward, and that closed-versus-open split is the whole charm of the pairing.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-suwannaphum: Jelly Crazies draws every line like a pen of constant weight, wobbly and nearly sealed in the bowls. The heading plays loudly; Suwannaphum, high and open, does the quiet reading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-instrument-sans: Jelly Crazies wobbles playfully, its bowls nearly sealed shut. Instrument Sans, with its pincer-open c and uniform strokes, has room to be sized up a little so it holds its own beside the heading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-inter: Wobbly fun on top, smooth tubing below. Jelly Crazies sets the mood, and Inter, its big counters breathing open, would carry paragraphs onward smoothly and without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-mulish: Mulish has uniform strokes, horseshoe-open apertures and a large x-height with short ascenders, all modern, plain and approachable. Jelly Crazies wobbles above it, bowls nearly shut, adding some welcome bounce.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-rubik: Jelly Crazies keeps a technical-drawing-pen line, wobbly yet uniform, with bowls that nearly seal shut. And Rubik's soft, open rounds stay legible at small sizes, which is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-joystix-bitter: Joystix spaces its arcade capitals wide, with stems barely heavier than the arms joining them. But Bitter, a slab-serif with big lowercase and see-through s, would read in a grounded, dependable way down the column.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-epunda-slab: Arcade energy runs through Joystix, whose curves are only a little heavier than its joins. Epunda Slab takes the quieter job, a dignified serif with a gaping c, tall rounded lowercase, made for reading.
